_about: Curated distrust list. Match every certificate the server presents by cert_sha256 AND by spki_sha256 (the SPKI match also catches cross-signed copies of the same key). Source: Qualys advisory for CVE-2026-111943 (2026-10-23). Before shipping, cross-check fingerprints against Dennis Jackson's published list or CCADB, and fill spki_sha256 by fetching each cert from crt.sh by its SHA-256.
